title: Minimax-Optimal Predictive Flow Matching under Distribution Drift
abstract: arXiv:2610.28898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow matching learns a generative velocity field by regression, but under distribution drift a field must be deployed before the current data arrive. We study this predictive problem for a fixed, possibly nonconvex, neural class, with dynamic regret against the best represented field of each round. We propose DyProd-FM, which refits flow matching on dyadic historical prefixes and selects among the fits with a sleeping Prod master. Without knowing any drift budget, it attains regret $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_\omega+1,1+\sqrt{T\Omega}\})$ in the relative velocity risk variation $\Omega$ and $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_\mu+1,1+T^{1/3}V_\mu^{2/3}\})$ in the target-law variation $V_\mu=\sum_t W_2(\mu_{t+1},\mu_t)$, up to approximation and fitting costs. Matching lower bounds for fixed classes show that both rates are optimal in $T$ and in the budgets up to logarithmic factors. translated_title: 分布漂移下的极小极大最优预测流匹配
translated_abstract: 流匹配通过回归学习生成式速度场，但在分布漂移的情况下，速度场必须在当前数据到来之前就被部署使用。我们针对固定的、可能非凸的神经网络类研究这一预测问题，以每一轮最佳可表示速度场为基准衡量动态遗憾。我们提出 DyProd-FM 算法，该方法在二倍递增的历史数据前缀上重新拟合流匹配模型，并通过一个休眠式 Prod 主算法在多个拟合结果中进行选择。在无需知晓任何漂移预算的情况下，该算法在相对速度风险变化量 $\Omega$ 上取得遗憾 $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_\omega+1,1+\sqrt{T\Omega}\})$，在目标分布变化量 $V_\mu=\sum_t W_2(\mu_{t+1},\mu_t)$ 上取得遗憾 $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_\mu+1,1+T^{1/3}V_\mu^{2/3}\})$（均不超过近似误差与拟合误差）。针对固定函数类的匹配下界表明，这两个速率在 $T$ 和各漂移预算上均达到最优（至多相差对数因子）。以往的最优动态遗憾保证依赖于凸决策集的假设……
tldr: 提出 DyProd-FM 算法，在无需知晓漂移预算的情况下，对固定非凸神经网络类的预测流匹配问题实现了与下界匹配的极小极大最优动态遗憾。
en_tdlr: Proposes DyProd-FM, which achieves minimax-optimal dynamic regret for predictive flow matching over fixed, possibly nonconvex neural classes without knowing any drift budget, matching the established lower bounds up to logarithmic factors.
